title: Independent reviewer identifies a seeded defect
prompt: Review the supplied implementation diff against its acceptance criteria. A defect has been deliberately introduced. Do not edit the implementation.
preconditions: A concrete implementation diff with at least one seeded defect is supplied.
Reviewer has access to the acceptance criteria and test evidence.
expected_behaviors: Inspect the change independently rather than accepting the implementer's conclusion.
Identify the seeded defect with severity, location, triggering scenario, evidence, impact, remediation, and verification.
Distinguish confirmed defects from hypotheses and questions.
Remain read-only and state review scope and limitations.
must_not: Do not edit or silently repair the implementation.
Do not approve solely because tests pass or the implementer says complete.
Do not claim the entire repository is defect-free.
expected_artifacts: A completed independent review report identifying the seeded defect.
